contigs.title: Contigs
contigs.description: String controlling which residues are fixed and which are hallucinated. Segments within a chain group are separated by '/'; independent chain groups are separated by a space. A chain-prefixed segment (e.g. 'A20-50') keeps those residues fixed from the input structure. A bare numeric range (e.g. '30-50') instructs the model to hallucinate a new chain of 30 to 50 residues. '/0' appended to a fixed segment marks a chain break with no additional hallucinated residues on that chain. Binder design example: 'A18-132/0 10-40' - fix chain A residues 18-132, then design a new binder of 10-40 residues. Multi-receptor example: 'A1-100/0 B1-80/0 50-100' - fix chains A and B, then design a binder of 50-100 residues. Inpainting example: 'A1-4/1-1/A6-7/13-13/A21-200' - fix A1-4, hallucinate 1 residue (replacing A5), fix A6-7, hallucinate 13 residues (replacing A8-20), fix A21-200. Chain IDs and residue indexes must exactly match the input structure.

hotspot_res.title: Hotspot Res
hotspot_res.description: Optional. Residues on the fixed receptor that the designed binder should contact. Use chain-prefixed identifiers, e.g. 'A55-57, B10'. Ranges and single residues may be separated by commas or whitespace. Leave empty or null for unconditional backbone generation.

random_seed.title: Random Seed
random_seed.description: Optional. Integer seed for reproducible generation. Leave unset for a random seed.

compare_binder.title: Compare Binder
compare_binder.description: Optional. Set to 1 to run sequence design and structure prediction after backbone generation, returning an aligned comparison structure. Set to 0 (default) to return only the backbone.

diffusion_steps.title: Diffusion Steps
diffusion_steps.description: Optional. Number of diffusion steps. Default is 50; specify only when you want to override it.

input_structure.title: Input Structure
input_structure.description: TOS URI or local path to the input protein structure in PDB/mmCIF format.

custom_output_path.title: Custom Output Path
custom_output_path.description: Resolved output destination. Set by framework - see gateway.source.ApiSource.resolve_output_dest().
